title: Solid build and quality feel
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the car as solid in build, body feel, interior fittings, and driving character, with isolated mention of doors feeling less solid and one unclear bottle-rattle comment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise a solid body and interior, good perceived build quality, and a smooth drive that feels refined and safe.

negative.summary: The negative review says the doors do not seem very solid.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review mentions bottles rattling in unclamped front bottle holders, but the sample is insufficient to tell whether this reflects overall cabin quality.

limitations: Examples are heavily concentrated on general impressions of solidity and quality, so detail on specific components is limited.
The undetermined rattle example is too limited to classify as a clear quality complaint for the broader topic.
Samples are stratified and not representative of all reviews.
